# P32.15 — per-island JS/network budget measurements

Measured on the built `web/dist` of the P32.15 implementation (revision `3c9ea94`, fixtures mode) by `web/scripts/measure-island-budgets.mjs`. The S4 research target is **≤1 MiB compressed** initial island assets and ≤2 MiB initial visible tiles (a measured baseline, then a hard ceiling). Enforced ceilings live in `web/tests/e2e/island-budgets.json` (wire-measured by `tests/e2e/budget.spec.ts`) and mirrored in `web/lighthouserc.json` assertMatrix blocks. The zero-JS public pages keep their 0-script / ≤150 KiB contract — nothing here relaxes it.
